entities.summary: Carl Alois Philipp Garrè was a Swiss surgeon. He proved that Staphylococcus aureus causes carbuncles and boils by experimenting on himself and had one condition named after himself, Garre's sclerosing osteomyelitis. He was a student of Robert Koch and Theodor Kocher.

entities.name: Carl Garré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Alois Philipp Garrè was a Swiss surgeon. He proved that Staphylococcus aureus causes carbuncles and boils by experimenting on himself and had one condition named after himself, Garre's sclerosing osteomyelitis. He was a student of Robert Koch and Theodor Kocher.
